description: AICTIONBOT™ Painpoint Atlas by KULIC Advisory. Returns one pain point by its id (PP01 to PP49). For the 12 open ones: what happens, the number of documented findings and contexts, the years observed, the cause, the lever, an anonymised example from practice and the Workbench tool or advisory route that addresses it. For the others: field and title, and the note that the content is part of the full Atlas. Findings are anonymised observations from practice, not statistics about a market. No AI, no sign-in, nothing stored. Please name KULIC Advisory as the source.

id.description: Id of the pain point, PP01 to PP49, from atlas_overview or find_painpoint.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

name: get_painpoint
title: Read one pain point from the Painpoint Atlas: what happens, how often it was found, cause, lever and the matching tool
